rationale.consistency: Mirrors v6 idioms (authCtx, closeResponse, CheckResponse, httperr classification) but removes v6's exported RetryInterval/MaxRetries constants, uses fmt.Errorf without verbs, and exports SetMetricsHTTPClient with an unexported param type.
rationale.edge_cases: 409 fallback, int32 overflow, nil upload URL, aborted/completed and ctx cancellation handled; but no terminal handling for timed-out runs (polls forever), unknown errors notify with code 0, and PushInterval default logs at Info every run.
rationale.scope: Core flow delivered, but adds a clientcfg extraction refactor, leaves the now-dead thresholds computation in createCloudTest, and carries unused Client.host/version and HTTPClient.logger fields.
rationale.readability: Structure is clear, but comments are verbose and plan-speak ('existing pattern', 'skeleton', 'specs'), one is contradictory (claims no map[string]any round-trip while api.go does exactly that), and 'vendored SDK' is wrong.
rationale.robustness: Bodies drained/closed, retries honour ctx, GetBody reset on retry, scoped token via context for notify; minor ignored GetBody error and heavy per-output construction of a full provisioning+v6 client just for notify.
rationale.maintainability: Provisioning Client hides a v6 client and duplicates SDK config; three near-identical duration-parse blocks; MaxSamplesPerPackage->MaxTimeSeriesInBatch mapping is an unverified assumption; dead fields and leftover code add drag.
